readings.B: binary64 in the TypeScript order (prepareQsoSource/prepareQsoProfile, galaxyChannelGrid for 600, multiSpecGrid for 400, sampleUniformSpectrum); digests are SHA-256 of the float64-LE channel values; maxHex is the binary64 bit pattern (big-endian hex) of the largest channel
readings.X: x87 model: 64-bit significand, nearest-even after every operation; control word, FISTP rounding, the Extended 1e-5 constant and the quadratic sum order are assumed [I]; used only to bound |B - X| off ties
readings.E: exact: u = i*count/N with no clamp; tie channels are (i*count) mod N == N/2, listed [I] (B and X may pick different stencil centres there); Round margins = |frac - 1/2| of restMin - 302 and restMax - restMin

namedRow: tieChannels[I] as [first, stride, number] (channels first + j*stride, j < number; [] when none)

sweep.encoding: per z (ascending), SHA-256 over the 780 ranges in order: int32-LE first, int32-LE count, 600 float64-LE values; a typed error is int32-LE -1 then the int32-LE code (redshift 1, window 2, normalization 3, range 4)

synthetic.encoding: outcome per range: o ready, z redshift, w window, n normalization, r range; digest as the sweep
